camera.title: Camera
camera.body: The camera lets you take a photo in the app, for example a profile picture or a scan.
camera.deniedBody: The camera prompt will not appear again. Turn the camera on in Settings to take a photo.

photos.title: Photos
photos.body: Photo access lets you choose a picture you already have and attach it.
photos.deniedBody: The photos prompt will not appear again. Turn photo access on in Settings to choose a picture.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: Notifications tell you when something you asked about is ready.
notifications.deniedBody: The notification prompt will not appear again. Turn notifications on in Settings to get those alerts.

location.title: Location
location.body: Location lets the app show nearby results and set your place on the map.
location.deniedBody: The location prompt will not appear again. Turn location on in Settings to see nearby results.

microphone.title: Microphone
microphone.body: The microphone lets you record a voice message in the app.
microphone.deniedBody: The microphone prompt will not appear again. Turn the microphone on in Settings to record.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.body: Contacts lets you pick a person to invite without typing their details.
contacts.deniedBody: The contacts prompt will not appear again. Turn contacts on in Settings to pick a person.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.body: Calendar access lets the app add an event you create to your calendar.
calendar.deniedBody: The calendar prompt will not appear again. Turn calendar access on in Settings to add the event.

bluetooth.title: Bluetooth
bluetooth.body: Bluetooth lets the app connect to a nearby device it works with.
bluetooth.deniedBody: The Bluetooth prompt will not appear again. Turn Bluetooth access on in Settings to connect.

consent.title: Analytics and crash reports
consent.body: When this is on, the app sends product events to PostHog and crash reports to Sentry. When it is off, neither receives anything.

billing.premiumActive: Premium is active on this account.
billing.noPlans: No plans are available right now.
